scope: Normal native PostgreSQL PC skill use: generate and persist source rank/attack-speed/shared-kind cooldowns without an optional gameplay chart.

source_behavior.contract: Own base delay + (rank-1)*signed increment + attack delay, DWORD multiply by rate, integer divide by 100. SDELAY_KIND returns kind delay directly. Use extends only when new duration exceeds remaining.

Base class/race DEX/WIS formulae; powered equipment slots 0/1 for physical and magic, slot 2 for ranged; passive rate changes before capped item magic reductions; same-kind learned set includes kind zero.
HavePower is true when durability maximum is zero or current durability is nonzero.

pinned_content.attack_formula_values: Both original formulae have init/rateX/rateY zero. Weapon delays are still applied; tests do not fabricate missing base speed.

wire_fixture.note: Synthetic learned ranks, owned equipment and resource values only; all template/formula/magic definitions remain original and read-only.

implementation.cache: Static skill timing fields and physical/ranged/magic character timing are rebuilt during fresh and transfer hydration. No new wire fields, persistent columns or SQL grants.
implementation.arithmetic: Preserves source DWORD additions/multiplication wrap before division, FLOAT base-formula evaluation, rank-zero branch and signed reuse increments. Rejects unsupported out-of-range INT/FLOAT conversions before mutation.
implementation.atomicity: Character lock encloses affordability, cooldown gate, own/shared timer mutation and resource deduction. The timer lock covers the entire same-kind update; rejected use leaves all timers/resources unchanged. Existing longer peer timers retain their origins.
implementation.equipment: Powered equipped slots contribute dwSpeedInc and source-projected magic values; broken items contribute neither. Rate reductions cap at 100 percent.
implementation.passives: Remaining-skill SA_CONTINUE/SA_PASSIVE ability deltas for MTYPE_PAS/LAS/MPAS are applied to rate 100 before equipment. The pinned release has no such rows; nonzero arithmetic is tested with explicit deterministic synthetic values.
implementation.active_effect_boundary: Buff-bearing transfer graphs retain their complete effects but omit cached attack timing. Speed-dependent casts throw before mutation and follow existing close/save handling. TAD_NONE continues with delay zero/rate 100 as in source.
implementation.durability: Existing skill/core receipts, snapshots, relogin and transfer recovery carry newly generated timers without a schema change. Cached definitions/timing are never serialized as player data.
implementation.migration: None. Both backups and migrations 001-021 remain unchanged; next schema migration remains 022.

targeted.scope: Deterministic formula/rank/wrap/boundary tests, shared-kind non-shortening and cross-skill concurrency, real plain/encrypted admission with rank/weapon/rate timing and unsupported-state refusal.

regression_before.expected_failure: Native skill wire: newly used native skill rejects immediate repeat without imported timer or optional chart
regression_before.scope: Previous installed daemon with current mounted backend integration executable and the same new encrypted TCP checks.

limitations: Active buff/disarm/disguise timing and effect expiration remain unported; speed-dependent buff-bearing casts fail closed.
Loop, cancellation, full target/action conditions, learning/rank changes, combat damage/healing and other gameplay remain separate ports.
Future supported equipment/learned-skill changes must refresh derived timing; current native payload is immutable between hydrations.
Original client executable not run; packet acceptance uses source-derived encrypted synthetic peers.
CHARINFO send-instant timer refresh remains pending. Periodic durability can lose state after the last committed checkpoint on a crash.
The optional no-payload legacy path retains its existing base-delay behavior; this increment verifies native character payloads.
